_comment: Lenient decode of a reported MessageContent (messaging.v1; moderation.v1 ReportContentRequest.message_payload). Field 1 (text) and field 2 (shared_post_id) are taken only with the length-delimited wire type, the last occurrence winning; every other field or wire type is skipped; invalid UTF-8 becomes U+FFFD; want_wire_ok is false only for bytes that are not well-formed protobuf. Go: backend/internal/moderation/decode_vectors_test.go. Dart: the client plan's report decoder runs the same rows (so what the reporter sees is what the moderator gets). Expected strings are after the U+FFFD replacement; want_shared_post_id is before the server's 19-digit check.
